name: Librewolf
tagline: A custom and independent version of Firefox, with the primary goals of privacy, security and user freedom. LibreWolf also aims to remove all the telemetry, data collection and annoyances, as well as disabling anti-freedom features like DRM.
description: LibreWolf is a custom and independent version of Firefox, with the primary goals of privacy, security and user freedom. LibreWolf also aims to remove all the telemetry, data collection and annoyances, as well as disabling anti-freedom features like DRM.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/librewolf:158.0.1@sha256:78298efcbb552eb51e537758088f28c47c065f7fb2877fc0248b1e291937603c
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      LIBREWOLF_CLI: ''
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
